nodes.label: Management API SDK
nodes.rationale: Typed endpoint methods remove auth and refresh boilerplate, reducing errors in production provisioning flows; Platform API evolves independently from Prisma ORM, so inspect the installed package's api.d.ts.

nodes.label: One-Time Service Token Value Disclosure
nodes.rationale: A newly created token's data.value is returned exactly once; transfer it directly to the intended secret store without logging the response — later list calls return only metadata and valueHint.
